description: This file defines an API client module for interacting with backend services in a React-based application. It includes methods for making HTTP requests, handling mock data, and domain-specific functions like fetching users and audit logs.

methods.name: wrap(promise)
methods.description: Wraps an async promise call to return a standardized response object with data and error fields.

methods.name: request(method, path, body)
methods.description: Low-level helper function to perform HTTP requests, throwing errors for mock mode or unsuccessful responses.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a specified path.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to a specified path with a request body.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to a specified path with a request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to a specified path.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Domain-specific method to retrieve user list, optionally using mock data.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Domain-specific method to create a new user, optionally using mock data.

methods.name: getAuditLogs
methods.description: Domain-specific method to retrieve audit logs, optionally using mock data.
